mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.source_id AS videoId, d.is_read AS isRead, d.cue_words_id AS cueWordsId, v.video_name AS videoName, v.start_time AS startTime, v.end_time AS endTime, v.duration, v.trade_id AS tradeId, v.sec_uid AS secUid FROM tb_diagnosis_cue d INNER JOIN tb_anchor_video v ON d.source_id = v.video_id WHERE d.source_type = 1 AND d.diagnosis_type = 1 AND d.is_read = 0 AND d.qa_status = 2 AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND v.video_slice_type = #{videoSliceType}
